summaries.text:
Emergency Medical Services Reimbursement for On-Scene and Support Act

This bill provides for Medicare coverage of ambulance services regardless of whether the ambulance transports the patient elsewhere.

title: Emergency Medical Services Reimbursement for On-Scene and Support Act
